name: deepscientist-lite
description: A bounded, recoverable, evidence-aware worker protocol for small and medium research tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Keep bounded research work recoverable and reviewable.
interface.longDescription: DeepScientist Lite Core is the domain-neutral worker protocol. Nine skills preserve goals, routes, experiments, evidence, reviews, iterations, delegation, handoffs, and bounded foreground autonomy contracts in project files. It does not provide a daemon, scheduler, browser service, knowledge base, or academic tool bundle.
defaultPrompt: $ds-lite inspect this research or engineering project, explain why the core applies, route one bounded action, and stop
$ds-lite-iterate advance one plan-execute-verify-reflect-report cycle and stop at a visible checkpoint
$ds-lite-review check whether this experiment is ready to support an analysis
